models_evaluated: SMS multilingual chatbot for perioperative instructions

links.outcome: Chatbot conversational engagement in LEP versus English-primary-language patients
links.effect: No difference in engagement between LEP and EPL patients (12.3 vs 12.2 text responses, P = .959).
links.quote: There was no difference in the conversational engagement between LEP patients and those with English as their primary language (EPL) (12.3 versus 12.2 text responses, P = .959).

unlisted_practices: Multilingual SMS chatbot delivering perioperative instructions to limited English proficiency patients to improve engagement and outcomes

screen.reason: Evaluates patient engagement and clinical outcomes of a multilingual SMS chatbot deployed in perioperative care for total joint arthroplasty patients with limited English proficiency.
